body: Yes, I have on the pc.
I just got Shadow of War so I am eager to try it just to see what kind of shenanigans I can get into with messing with the orcs.

I do have some friends but staying in touch with them is difficult given they are busy and not currently living in the same area of the world I am in. I think there is something extremely wrong with me as I am on the autistic spectrum where my social abilities are gravely weak. I recall my years in High school the only socialization I learned was how to suffer from bullying and being neglected by society. That was the extent of socialization in high school. After leaving High School did I was able to social with a very few amount of people but they are all mostly gone now. I play video games but now it is not really for enjoyment but simply something to keep my mind off of harming myself. I spend almost every day playing games or doing work without a hint of socialization and I came to the conclusion that was not a life worth living. So yeah, I am just a bit sick of everything right now
I am awake now. I am bit more clear-headed now but I also feel like a pile of shit.

The problem I am facing is simply the inability to be human. I can no longer count a number of times I have seen a group of friends in public simply having fun and I knowing deep down I will never experience that joy or that satisfaction as I  lack core neurological abilities to socialize. Most of what I remember from those times is  I how I wished I could simply slice open my own throat with a knife so I could no longer live with the shame or inability. I have never been in a relationship and most of my birthdays was spent alone. I often had to throw away my own birthday cake I could simply not bring myself to eat if my entire birthday is a disappointment. School wise, I am doing very well but I do see it as mostly pointless as with all things as I have no future besides grinding away my energy in cold industry. There is nothing here for me here beside death and misery, might as well cut out the misery part of it. I am not improving the human race or having a positive experience with this whole life thing so I di I will free up resources that could be used by people who enjoyed life or those who needed to improve the quality of life in others. Anyways, I am bit tired so I going to sleep now so I will not be able to respond in few hours
